verdict.rationale: Procurement intake is a fair question for a spend-management and banking product, so the axis applies. However, the evidence only shows AI that reads bills and auto-populates bill-payment details. Nothing in the pack documents parsing vendor contracts or any procurement request form for AI to fill, and that adjacent bill-pay feature earns no credit for this story.

support.subject: As an ai-native user, I can have vendor contracts parsed by AI to auto-populate procurement request forms
